narrative.intro: Blue Origin obligated $99.2M in federal contracts in FY2027 to date. Blue Origin received 2 federal awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $49.6M. Obligations fell 90.9% year over year. Historical obligations show large swings across recent years: Blue Origin obligated $357K in FY22, $15.8M in FY23, $10.6M in FY24, $106M in FY25, and $1.1B in FY26 before the current FY27 total of $99.2M. The current-year totals are partial because the period shown is FY2027 to date. The reported figures are contract obligations, except where award-value figures appear in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables as total contract values. Use these figures to compare year-to-date federal demand for Blue Origin against full-year results in prior fiscal years, and to assess the concentration of obligation dollars into the small number of FY2027 awards so far.

sections.heading: How have obligations changed by fiscal year?
sections.body: Blue Origin obligated $357K in FY22, $15.8M in FY23, $10.6M in FY24, $106M in FY25, $1.1B in FY26, and $99.2M in FY27 to date. Obligations rose sharply into FY26 and then fell 90.9% year over year into FY27 to date. The year-to-date FY27 total of $99.2M reflects only partial current-year activity.
